questions.label: Name / Nickname
questions.detail: Text input. Used for personalised greeting.

questions.label: Age
questions.detail: Number between 16 and 70. Adjusts plan intensity and recovery time.

questions.label: Gender
questions.detail: Male / Female / Prefer not to say. Influences calorie targets.

questions.label: Height
questions.detail: In cm or ft/in. Used in BMI and TDEE calculation.

questions.label: Current Weight
questions.detail: In kg or lbs. Baseline for tracking progress.

questions.label: Target Weight
questions.detail: In kg or lbs. Determines the size of the goal gap.

questions.label: Body Type
questions.detail: Ectomorph (naturally slim) / Mesomorph (athletic build) / Endomorph (naturally heavier). Shapes nutrition ratios.

questions.label: Gym Experience
questions.detail: Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced. Sets exercise difficulty and volume.

questions.label: Fitness Goal
questions.detail: Weight Loss / Bulking / Cutting / Shredding. Determines the entire plan.

questions.label: Equipment Access
questions.detail: Home only / Full gym / Both. Filters exercise options accordingly.

questions.label: Health Conditions
questions.detail: None / Injury / Medical condition. Used as a safety flag for exercise modifications.

programmes.name: Weight Loss
programmes.blurb: Reduce overall body fat with cardio and circuits.
programmes.description: This plan combines metabolic conditioning, circuit training and steady-state cardio to maximise calorie burn while preserving lean muscle. Paired with a moderate calorie deficit.

macros.generalRule: 2g protein per kg of bodyweight. Calories to be 400–600 below your TDEE.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.description: Stand upright, jump feet apart and raise arms overhead. Return to start. Keep core braced throughout.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.description: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Lower hips until thighs are parallel to floor. Drive through heels to stand.

exercises.name: Push-Ups
exercises.description: Hands shoulder-width, body straight. Lower chest to floor then press back up. Keep elbows at 45 degrees.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.description: Plank position. Drive alternating knees to chest rapidly. Keep hips level and core tight throughout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 12 reps each side, 45 sec rest
exercises.description: Lean forward with one hand on bench. Pull dumbbell to hip, elbow driving back. Squeeze shoulder blade at top.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.description: Squat down, jump feet back to plank, do a push-up, jump feet in, then explode upward with arms raised.

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.description: Forearms on floor, body straight. Squeeze glutes and core. Don't let hips sag or rise. Breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Treadmill Jog
exercises.description: Maintain moderate effort (5–6 out of 10). Incline 1–2% on treadmill. Focus on steady breathing.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.prescription: 4 sets x 12 reps each leg, 45 sec rest
exercises.description: Step forward and lower back knee toward floor. Push off front foot to bring feet together and repeat other leg.

exercises.name: Sumo Squats
exercises.description: Wide stance, toes out 45 degrees. Lower hips keeping chest up. Drive hips up and squeeze glutes at top.

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
exercises.description: Lie on back, knees bent. Drive hips to ceiling, squeeze glutes hard at top. Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Step-Ups
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 15 reps each leg, 45 sec rest
exercises.description: Use a bench or step. Drive through the heel of the working leg. Don't push off the trailing foot.

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.description: Lie flat, hands under hips. Raise straight legs to 90 degrees and lower slowly without touching the floor.

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.description: Sit at 45 degrees, feet off floor. Rotate torso fully side to side. Hold a weight for added resistance.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.description: Hands behind head. Alternate bringing elbow to opposite knee. Extend other leg long. Do not pull neck.

exercises.name: Jump Rope / Skipping
exercises.description: Keep a light rhythmic bounce. Jump low and land softly on balls of feet. If no rope, mimic the movement.

days.title: Active Recovery
days.restNote: No resistance training. Suggested activities: 30-minute walk, foam rolling, yoga, or light swimming. Drink at least 3 litres of water. Focus on stretching tight areas from the first two days.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Sit or stand. Press dumbbells from ear height to above head. Lower controlled. Don't arch lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls
exercises.description: Stand, palms forward. Curl both dumbbells to shoulders squeezing biceps. Lower slowly over 3 seconds.

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
exercises.description: Hands on chair edge behind you. Lower body by bending elbows to 90 degrees, press back up. Keep back close to chair.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Rows
exercises.description: Hinge at hips 45 degrees, back flat. Pull dumbbells to ribcage, elbows close. Squeeze back at top.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.description: Run on the spot driving knees above hip height. Pump arms. Stay on balls of feet. Maximum effort.

exercises.name: Jump Squats
exercises.description: Squat then explode upward. Land softly with bent knees, absorb impact through legs. Reset before next rep.

exercises.name: Push-Up to Shoulder Tap
exercises.description: Do a push-up, at the top tap each shoulder alternately. Keep hips square. Core tight.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine or Bike
exercises.description: Aim for 70% max heart rate. Focus on breathing rhythm throughout.

exercises.name: Squat to Press
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells at shoulders. Squat down, stand and press overhead in one fluid motion.

exercises.name: Renegade Rows
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 10 reps each side, 60 sec rest
exercises.description: Plank with dumbbells. Row one dumbbell to hip, return, repeat other side. Keep hips still.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunges
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 12 reps each side, 45 sec rest
exercises.description: Step wide to one side, bend that knee, keep other leg straight. Push back to centre. Chest stays up.

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.description: Lie flat, legs raised 15cm. Alternate small up-down kicks. Keep lower back pressed into floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Deadlift
exercises.description: Feet hip-width, dumbbells in front of thighs. Hinge at hips keeping back flat. Drive hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: Speed Skaters
exercises.description: Leap laterally landing on one foot, sweep other leg behind. Mimic an ice skater. Stay light on feet.

exercises.name: Stair Climb or Incline Walk
exercises.description: High incline (12–15%). Swing arms naturally. Maintain steady pace throughout.

exercises.name: Long Walk or Light Jog
exercises.description: Steady low-intensity pace. Heart rate at 60–65% max. Ideal outdoors for mental health benefits.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 10 reps each side, 30 sec rest
exercises.description: Lie on back, arms up, knees at 90 degrees. Lower opposite arm and leg simultaneously without back lifting.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 30 seconds each side, 30 sec rest
exercises.description: Body in straight line, one forearm on floor. Stack feet or stagger. Don't let hips drop.

exercises.name: V-Sit Hold
exercises.description: Sit, lean back 45 degrees, raise legs to form a V. Hold with arms forward. Bend knees slightly if needed.

exercises.name: Slow Bicycle Crunches
exercises.description: Same as bicycle crunch but 3-second tempo. Full extension of leg and full rotation of torso each rep.

exercises.name: Foam Roll and Stretch
exercises.description: Roll quads, hamstrings, calves, IT band. Hold each stretch 30–45 seconds. Focus on tight areas.

days.title: Full Rest
days.restNote: Complete rest. No training. Hydrate well, sleep 7–9 hours, and prepare meals for the week ahead. Let your body fully recover before the next cycle begins.

diet.intro: High protein, moderate carb, low fat. Aim for a calorie deficit of 400–600 below your TDEE. Prioritise whole foods and avoid processed sugar.

dailyMeals.name: Oats with berries and protein powder
dailyMeals.items_note: 80g oats, 1 scoop protein powder, 100g mixed berries. Slow-release energy, high fibre, antioxidants.

dailyMeals.name: Greek yogurt and almonds
dailyMeals.items_note: 170g 0% Greek yogurt, 20g almonds. High protein, healthy fats, keeps hunger away.

dailyMeals.name: Grilled chicken with quinoa and salad
dailyMeals.items_note: 180g chicken breast, 80g quinoa, mixed leaves. Lean protein, complete amino acids, complex carbs.

dailyMeals.name: Apple with peanut butter
dailyMeals.items_note: 1 medium apple, 1 tablespoon peanut butter. Natural sugar and healthy fat for sustained energy.

dailyMeals.name: Baked salmon with sweet potato and broccoli
dailyMeals.items_note: 180g salmon, 150g sweet potato, 200g broccoli. Omega-3, slow carbs, vitamins, very filling.

dailyMeals.name: Cottage cheese
dailyMeals.items_note: 150g low-fat cottage cheese. Casein protein is slow digesting, ideal before sleep to feed muscles overnight.

foodsToAvoid: Sugary drinks: fizzy drinks, fruit juice, sports drinks with added sugar
Processed snacks: crisps, biscuits, chocolate bars, white bread
Fried foods: chips, fried chicken, battered fish
Alcohol: empty calories that impair recovery and fat burning
High-sugar cereals and instant oatmeal with added sugar

programmes.name: Bulking
programmes.blurb: Build maximum muscle mass with heavy compound lifts.
programmes.description: This plan focuses on progressive overload with heavy compound movements to stimulate maximum muscle growth. Paired with a calorie surplus to fuel muscle building.

macros.generalRule: Eat 300–500 calories above your TDEE. 2–2.5g protein per kg of bodyweight.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Lie on bench, bar above chest. Lower to lower chest, press explosively up. Keep feet flat, arch natural.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Bench at 30–45 degrees. Press dumbbells from chest level up. Feel the upper chest stretch at bottom.

exercises.name: Cable Flyes
exercises.description: Arms wide, slight elbow bend. Bring hands together in front of chest in an arc. Squeeze pecs hard at the top.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.description: Lean forward slightly, elbows flared. Lower until shoulders are below elbows. Press back up. Full range of motion.

exercises.name: Skull Crushers
exercises.description: Lie on bench, EZ bar above forehead. Bend elbows lowering bar near forehead. Extend back up. Control the lowering.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdowns
exercises.description: Cable at shoulder height. Press bar down until arms fully extended. Keep elbows fixed at sides. Squeeze at bottom.

exercises.name: Push-Up Burnout
exercises.description: Standard push-ups until form breaks. This is a finishing set only. Don't sacrifice form for extra reps.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.description: Bar over mid-foot. Grip outside legs. Push the floor away rather than pulling. Lock hips and shoulders rising together.

exercises.name: Pull-Ups or Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: Full hang, pull elbows to sides, chest to bar. Use lat pulldown machine if pull-ups are not yet possible.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Rows
exercises.description: Sit upright, pull handle to lower ribs. Squeeze shoulder blades together. Don't rock torso backward.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 10 reps each side, 60 sec rest
exercises.description: Support on bench. Pull dumbbell to hip, elbow drives straight back. Full stretch at bottom.

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.description: Cable at forehead height. Pull rope to face, elbows high. Externally rotate at end. Great for posture.

exercises.name: Barbell Bicep Curl
exercises.description: Stand, shoulder-width grip, curl to shoulders. Squeeze hard. Lower over 3 seconds. No swinging.

exercises.name: Hammer Curls
exercises.description: Palms facing each other. Curl alternately. Slow negative phase for maximum muscle growth stimulus.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.description: Bar on traps. Feet shoulder-width. Sit back and down keeping chest tall. Drive through heels to lockout.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: Hinge at hips, slight knee bend, bar slides down legs. Feel the hamstring stretch, drive hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.description: Push platform away through heels. Don't lock knees at top. Lower slowly. Full range of motion every rep.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 12 reps each leg, 60 sec rest
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells at sides. Large step forward, lower back knee near floor. Push through front heel. Alternate.

exercises.name: Leg Curl Machine
exercises.description: Lie face down. Curl heels toward glutes. Squeeze hamstrings hard at top. Lower slowly over 3 seconds.

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.description: On a step edge. Lower heel fully then raise up on toes and hold for 1 second. Full range. Use heavy weight if possible.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.description: Upper back on bench, bar across hips. Drive hips to ceiling, squeeze glutes hard at the top for 1 second.

days.title: Rest / Active Recovery
days.restNote: Light activity only. Suggested: 30-minute walk, foam rolling, or yoga. No resistance training. This rest day is essential for muscle repair and growth. Drink plenty of water and prioritise sleep.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.description: Press bar from collar bones to above head. Lock out elbows. Squeeze glutes to protect lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
exercises.description: Arms at sides, slight elbow bend. Raise to shoulder height, lead with elbows. Lower slowly. Don't shrug.

exercises.name: Front Raises
exercises.description: Use plates or dumbbells. Raise in front to shoulder height. Alternate arms. Control the return to avoid momentum.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.description: Start palms facing you at chin, rotate out as you press overhead. Reverse on the way down. Full rotation.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrugs
exercises.description: Hold bar at thighs. Shrug shoulders straight up to ears, hold 1 second. Don't roll shoulders.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Flyes
exercises.description: Bend over 90 degrees, dumbbells hanging. Raise arms to sides squeezing rear delts. Pinch shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Power Cleans
exercises.description: Bar from floor, explosive pull, catch in front rack position. Technical lift — start light and focus on form.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Variation
exercises.description: Wide, close or neutral grip. Full hang to chin above bar. Pause at the bottom to eliminate momentum.

exercises.name: Weighted Plank
exercises.description: Standard plank with a weight plate on lower back (have a partner place it). Maintain a straight body position.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 12 reps each side, 45 sec rest
exercises.description: Rotate from high cable to opposite low hip. Straight arms. Pivot rear foot. Core does the work, not arms.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.description: Kneel with wheel in hands. Roll forward until arms extended, return by contracting abs. Don't let hips drop.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.description: Hang from bar. Raise legs to 90 degrees or higher. Slow and controlled. Don't swing or use momentum.

days.title: Full Rest
days.restNote: Complete rest. No training at all. Eat your full calorie surplus, sleep 8+ hours and prepare for next week. Muscle grows during rest, not during training.

diet.intro: High calorie, high protein, high carb. Surplus of 300–500 calories above your TDEE. Focus on nutrient-dense whole foods. Avoid junk food even in a surplus — quality calories build better muscle.

dailyMeals.name: Whole eggs, oats and banana
dailyMeals.items_note: 4 whole eggs, 100g oats, 1 banana, 200ml whole milk. High calorie with protein and slow and fast carbs for energy.

dailyMeals.name: Mass shake or peanut butter toast
dailyMeals.items_note: 1 scoop protein, 500ml whole milk, 2 tbsp peanut butter on 2 slices brown bread. Dense calorie hit with protein and healthy fats.

dailyMeals.name: Beef mince with white rice and vegetables
dailyMeals.items_note: 200g lean beef mince, 150g white rice, mixed veg. Red meat provides creatine, fast carbs, essential vitamins.

dailyMeals.name: Rice cakes and protein bar
dailyMeals.items_note: 3 rice cakes, 1 quality protein bar (25g+ protein). Quick carbs for training energy with no gut discomfort.

dailyMeals.name: Protein shake and fruit
dailyMeals.items_note: 2 scoops whey, 1 banana, 250ml milk. Fast protein and simple carbs to spike insulin and shuttle nutrients to muscle.

dailyMeals.name: Chicken thighs, pasta and olive oil
dailyMeals.items_note: 250g chicken thighs, 200g pasta, 1 tbsp olive oil. High calorie, protein and fat dense evening meal.

dailyMeals.name: Casein shake or cottage cheese
dailyMeals.items_note: 200g full-fat cottage cheese or 1 scoop casein protein. Slow-digesting protein feeds muscle repair throughout the night.

foodsToAvoid: Fast food and takeaways — high trans fats impair hormone function
Alcohol — significantly suppresses testosterone and impairs muscle protein synthesis
Sugary cereals — cause blood sugar spikes with no muscle-building benefit
healthySnacks: Peanut butter on rice cakes (4–6 cakes)
Trail mix: almonds, cashews, walnuts, dried mango
Greek yogurt with honey and granola

programmes.name: Cutting
programmes.blurb: Lose fat while retaining muscle via strength training and moderate cardio.
programmes.description: Cutting combines strength training to preserve muscle mass with a moderate calorie deficit. Higher protein intake prevents muscle breakdown. Cardio is used strategically, not excessively.

macros.generalRule: 2.2–2.5g protein per kg of bodyweight. Deficit of 300–500 calories below TDEE.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Maintain strength from bulk. Lower weight slightly if needed. Full range of motion — touch chest and lock out.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Keep pressing volume high to retain chest muscle. Control the negative — 3 seconds on the way down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Seated for stability. Press from ear height to full extension. Don't flare elbows excessively.

exercises.name: Lateral Raises
exercises.description: Lighter weight, higher reps to maintain shoulder size while in a deficit. Strict form — no cheating.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdowns
exercises.description: Full extension each rep. Squeeze at bottom. Superset with push-ups if time allows.

exercises.name: Cable Flyes
exercises.description: Finish with isolation. Arms arc together, squeeze peak contraction for 2 seconds each rep.

exercises.name: HIIT Finisher
exercises.prescription: 1 x 10 minutes. 10 rounds: 30 seconds all-out effort (sprints or bike), 30 seconds rest
exercises.description: Maximum output each working interval.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
exercises.description: Keep heavy squats in the programme to preserve leg muscle. Don't reduce load too aggressively.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: Hamstring focus. Full stretch at bottom each rep. Controlled tempo — 2 seconds up, 3 seconds down.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 10 reps each leg, 60 sec rest
exercises.description: Rear foot elevated on bench. Lower back knee near floor. Great for quads and balance.

exercises.name: Leg Curl Machine
exercises.description: Full range. Squeeze hard at top. 3-second lower. Hamstrings respond well to slow reps.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.description: Extend to fully straight. Hold 1 second, lower slowly. Light to moderate weight for high reps.

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.description: Full range. Pause at top and bottom of each rep.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
exercises.description: Incline 12–15%, moderate pace. Low-impact fat burning that doesn't eat into muscle like excessive HIIT can during a deficit.

days.title: Active Recovery
days.restNote: Light activity only. Suggested: 30-minute walk, foam rolling, yoga, or light swimming. Flexibility work is especially important when calories are lower. Stay hydrated.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: Maintain heavy pulling. Strength is the key signal for muscle retention during a cut. Don't drop this lift.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Ups
exercises.description: Add belt weight if possible. Full hang to chin over bar. Cutting is not an excuse to lose pull-up strength.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.description: Elbows tight to body. Squeeze shoulder blades. 2 seconds pull, 3 seconds return. Feel the lats working.

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.description: Critical during a cut for shoulder health. External rotation. High rep, light to moderate weight.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.description: Maintain bicep training. Slow negative. No swinging or momentum at any point.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: Lie back on incline bench. Full stretch at bottom activates more bicep fibres. Very effective isolation.

exercises.name: Cardio
exercises.description: Moderate pace jog or bike. Zone 2 heart rate (60–70% max). Burns calories without causing a cortisol spike.

exercises.name: Squat to Press
exercises.description: Dumbbell front squat into overhead press. Compound movement burns more calories and works multiple muscle groups.

exercises.name: Push-Up Variations
exercises.description: Mix standard, wide, and close-grip. Higher reps with bodyweight burns calories and maintains chest endurance.

exercises.name: Pull-Up or Inverted Row
exercises.description: Bodyweight pulling. For inverted row, lie under bar at 45 degrees and pull chest to bar.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Complex
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 8 reps each movement, 75 sec rest
exercises.description: 6 deadlift, 6 row, 6 curl, 6 press without putting the weight down. One of the most effective cutting tools.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.description: Lie flat, arms overhead, feet 15cm up. Lower back pressed flat. Harder than it looks. Build toward 60 seconds.

exercises.name: Burpee Intervals
exercises.prescription: 3 sets. Tabata style: 20 seconds maximum effort burpees, 10 seconds rest
exercises.description: 8 rounds. Very effective for fat burning.

exercises.name: Stretching
exercises.description: Hold each position 30–45 seconds. Flexibility aids recovery when calories are reduced.

exercises.name: Outdoor Run or Cycle
exercises.description: Steady-state Zone 2. Conversational pace. Burns fat efficiently without muscle breakdown when protein intake is high.

exercises.name: Plank Variations
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 45 seconds each, 30 sec rest
exercises.description: Standard, side plank each side, reverse plank. Aim to increase hold time each week.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 10 reps each side, 30 sec rest
exercises.description: Opposite arm and leg lower together while back stays flat. Excellent for deep core stability.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 12 reps each side, 30 sec rest
exercises.description: High to low or low to high rotation. Rotate through torso. Builds oblique definition safely.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
exercises.description: Lower back stays on floor. Legs lower slowly without touching floor. Add ankle weights when this becomes easy.

exercises.name: Foam Rolling
exercises.description: Cover all major muscle groups: quads, hamstrings, lats, calves, thoracic spine. 30–60 seconds per area.

days.title: Full Rest
days.restNote: Complete rest. Eat your full calorie target, sleep 7–9 hours. Muscle is retained during recovery. Do not add extra cardio on rest days during a cut.

diet.intro: High protein is essential during a cut — it prevents muscle loss and keeps you full. Time carbohydrates around your workouts. Avoid crash dieting or dropping calories too low.

dailyMeals.name: Egg white omelette with spinach and wholemeal toast
dailyMeals.items_note: 6 egg whites (2 whole), large handful spinach, 1–2 slices wholemeal toast. High protein, low fat, rich in iron and vitamins.

dailyMeals.name: Protein shake and fruit
dailyMeals.items_note: 1 scoop whey protein in water, 1 apple. Keeps protein high between meals without excess calories.

dailyMeals.name: Turkey breast with brown rice and steamed veg
dailyMeals.items_note: 200g turkey breast, 80g dry brown rice, 200g vegetables. Lean protein, complex carbs, high volume and low calorie.

dailyMeals.name: Banana and protein shake
dailyMeals.items_note: 1 banana, half scoop protein. Carbs for training energy and protein to protect muscle during the session.

dailyMeals.name: Chicken breast and sweet potato
dailyMeals.items_note: 180g chicken breast, 150g sweet potato. Replenish glycogen and spike muscle protein synthesis.

dailyMeals.name: White fish with asparagus and green beans
dailyMeals.items_note: 220g cod or tilapia, 150g asparagus, green beans. Very low calorie, very high protein, highly nutrient dense.

dailyMeals.name: Casein protein or low-fat cottage cheese
dailyMeals.items_note: 1 scoop casein or 150g cottage cheese. Slow protein prevents overnight muscle breakdown.

foodsToAvoid: High calorie condiments: mayonnaise, full-fat dressings, creamy sauces
Liquid calories: juice, smoothies, lattes — add calories invisibly
White bread, white pasta, white rice (except post-workout)
Cheese and full-fat dairy — very calorie dense on a deficit
Alcohol — 7 calories per gram, no nutritional value, impairs fat burning for 24+ hours
healthySnacks: Boiled eggs — 2 to 3 with hot sauce
Edamame — high protein and low calorie

programmes.name: Shredding
programmes.blurb: Competition-level leanness with twice-daily sessions and carb cycling.
programmes.description: Shredding is the most intense goal. It requires an aggressive calorie deficit, twice-daily training on some days, carb cycling, and extreme dietary discipline. Not suitable for beginners. Please consult a GP before starting if you have any health conditions.

macros.highCarbDays: Add 150–200g carbs above baseline, timed around workouts.
macros.lowCarbDays: Reduce carbs by 100–150g. Increase protein slightly. Fibrous veg only for carbohydrates.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
exercises.description: Maintain heavy strength. Preserves muscle on an aggressive deficit. Do not reduce this lift.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.description: High volume after heavy squats. Full range of motion every rep. Don't lock knees at top.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.description: Quad isolation. Feet forward, close together. The quad burn should be intense.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: Hamstring focus after quad work. Controlled tempo. Feel the full stretch at the bottom each rep.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.description: Squeeze hard at top. 3-second negative. Hamstrings are critical for leg shape.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raises
exercises.description: Seated for the soleus. Full range, pause at top. Calves need high volume and frequency to develop.

sessions.label: Evening session (cardio, 45 minutes, at least 6 hours after morning)

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
exercises.description: Maximum fat burning zone. Do not hold handrails. Full leg engagement throughout.

exercises.name: Flat Bench Press
exercises.description: Keep pressing strength. 3-second negative for maximum muscle fibre engagement while in a deficit.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: High-rep incline for upper chest. Controlled tempo throughout. No bouncing off chest.

exercises.name: Pec Deck or Cable Fly
exercises.description: Full peak contraction each rep. 2-second hold at the squeeze. Arms arc, they don't press.

exercises.name: Close Grip Bench Press
exercises.description: Hands 30cm apart. Elbows tight to ribs. Primary tricep compound for this session.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.description: Both hands on one dumbbell overhead. Lower behind head, extend back up. Full range every rep.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdowns Drop Set
exercises.description: Heavy 10 reps, drop weight 20%, 10 more, drop 20%, to failure. Extremely effective for definition.

exercises.name: Sprint Intervals
exercises.prescription: 8 rounds: 30 seconds maximum sprint, 90 seconds rest
exercises.description: Go all out every sprint. Do not reduce effort — full speed each time.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: Maintain this lift at all costs during a shred. Greatest muscle engagement per rep of any exercise.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Ups
exercises.description: Add weight if possible. Full hang, chin over bar. Best lat builder and critical for a wide-back shredded physique.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.description: Mid-back thickness. Elbows drive back, not up. Chest on pad. Squeeze fully and lower controlled.

exercises.name: Wide Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: Wide overhand grip. Pull to upper chest, lean back slightly. Stretch fully at top each rep.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: Full stretch activates more fibres. Supinate as you curl. Squeeze hard at top.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.description: Elbow on inner thigh. Curl slowly to peak contraction. Best isolation for bicep peak development.

exercises.name: Plank to Pike
exercises.description: Start in plank, push hips to sky (downward dog), return. Intense core and shoulder combination.

exercises.name: V-Ups
exercises.description: Lie flat, simultaneously raise arms and legs to form a V shape. Keep arms and legs straight if possible. Slow return.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Heavy overhead pressing to retain shoulder mass. Don't sacrifice shoulder size during the shred.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.description: Rotation gives full deltoid engagement. Very effective for roundness and separation between heads.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise Drop Set
exercises.description: Standard weight to failure, drop 20%, to failure, drop 20%, to failure. Extreme metabolic stress on side delts.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 15 reps each arm, 30 sec rest
exercises.description: One arm at a time. Constant cable tension is superior to dumbbells for delt separation.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.description: Rear delt isolation. Essential for balanced shoulder development and good posture.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrugs
exercises.description: Higher reps during a shred. Keep traps engaged. Straight up, don't roll shoulders forward.

exercises.name: Cycling or Swimming
exercises.description: Low impact, ideal for recovery days from heavy lifting. Non-weight bearing protects joints under training stress.

exercises.name: Barbell Complex
exercises.prescription: 5 sets x 6 reps per movement, 90 sec rest
exercises.description: 6 deadlift, 6 bent row, 6 hang clean, 6 front squat, 6 press. Do NOT put bar down. One weight throughout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Thruster
exercises.description: DB front squat into overhead press. Continuous movement. One of the highest calorie burn exercises per minute.

exercises.name: Pull-Up to Knee Raise
exercises.description: Full pull-up at top, hold, raise knees to chest, lower. Extreme combination of core and back work.

exercises.name: Box Jump to Step Down
exercises.description: Explode onto box. Step down — do not jump — to protect the Achilles on high volume. Reset and repeat.

exercises.name: Renegade Row Push-Up
exercises.prescription: 3 sets x 8 reps each side, 60 sec rest
exercises.description: Plank with dumbbells. Push-up, row left, push-up, row right. Hips must stay perfectly still.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.description: Arms extended back, legs 15cm up, lower back pressed flat. Core endurance is essential at this level.

exercises.name: Sprint or Assault Bike
exercises.prescription: 10 rounds: 40 seconds maximum effort, 20 seconds rest
exercises.description: Assault bike or sprints. 40 seconds of absolute maximum every round. No holding back.

exercises.name: Burpee Intervals
exercises.description: Tabata protocol. One of the most effective fat burning protocols in sports science.

exercises.name: Yoga Flow or Full Stretch
exercises.description: Hip flexors, hamstrings, quads, shoulders, chest. Hold 45–60 seconds each. Full recovery is mandatory at this intensity level.

days.title: Full Rest — Mandatory
days.restNote: Complete rest. This is not optional. The twice-daily sessions earlier in the week require a full rest day for the central nervous system to recover. Sleep, eat well and prepare for next week.

diet.intro: Carb cycling means eating high carbs on training days and low carbs on rest days. Protein stays high on all days. This preserves muscle while aggressively targeting body fat.

trainingDayMeals.name: Egg whites, oats and berries
trainingDayMeals.items_note: 8 egg whites, 80g oats, 100g blueberries. High protein and complex carbs for the hard training day ahead.

trainingDayMeals.name: Protein shake and rice cakes
trainingDayMeals.items_note: 1.5 scoops whey, 4 rice cakes with almond butter. Sustained energy and protein for training.

trainingDayMeals.name: Chicken and rice
trainingDayMeals.items_note: 220g chicken breast, 150g white rice, broccoli, soy sauce. Lean protein and fast carbs. Classic shredding meal.

trainingDayMeals.name: Banana and BCAAs
trainingDayMeals.items_note: 1 banana, 10g BCAAs in water. Simple carbs spike energy and BCAAs protect muscle during intense training.

trainingDayMeals.name: Whey and dextrose
trainingDayMeals.items_note: 2 scoops whey, 50g dextrose powder in water. Immediate muscle protein synthesis and glycogen replenishment.

trainingDayMeals.name: Turkey and sweet potato
trainingDayMeals.items_note: 200g turkey mince, 150g sweet potato, asparagus. Moderate carbs and very high protein.

trainingDayMeals.name: Casein shake
trainingDayMeals.items_note: 1.5 scoops casein protein in water. 7–8 hours of slow-release amino acids protecting muscle during sleep.

restDayMeals.name: Whole eggs and smoked salmon
restDayMeals.items_note: 4 whole eggs, 100g smoked salmon, spinach. High fat and protein, zero carbs, enters fat burning mode immediately.

restDayMeals.name: Almonds and string cheese
restDayMeals.items_note: 30g almonds, 2 cheese sticks. Healthy fats, protein, zero carbs. Very filling for hunger management.

restDayMeals.name: Tuna salad with olive oil and avocado
restDayMeals.items_note: 2 cans tuna, large mixed salad, half avocado, olive oil dressing. High protein, healthy fats, negligible carbs.

restDayMeals.name: Protein shake in water
restDayMeals.items_note: 1.5 scoops whey in water only. Pure protein, no carbs, no fat. Keep protein high all day on low carb days.

restDayMeals.name: Steak and green vegetables
restDayMeals.items_note: 200g lean rump steak, green beans, broccoli, spinach. Red meat protein, zero carb vegetables, iron dense.

restDayMeals.name: Cottage cheese and walnuts
restDayMeals.items_note: 150g cottage cheese, 20g walnuts. Casein protein and omega-3 fats, minimal carbs, slow digestion for overnight recovery.

foodsToAvoid: Any added sugar in any form — sauces, condiments, drinks, seasonings
Alcohol — completely eliminates fat burning for 24–48 hours
Fruit juice — liquid fructose spikes insulin and stalls fat loss
Bread, pasta and cereals on rest days — even wholemeal
Cheat meals — even one can set back a week of progress at this stage
High-sodium processed foods — causes water retention and masks progress
supplements: Whey Protein Isolate — 2 to 3 servings daily to hit protein target
BCAAs — intra-workout on low carb days to prevent muscle breakdown
Creatine Monohydrate — 5g daily, maintains strength on a deficit
Caffeine or pre-workout — improves performance and fat mobilisation
Omega-3 Fish Oil — 3g daily for inflammation and joint health
Vitamin D and Zinc — supports testosterone, immune function and mood
